subject.title: feat(google-meet): retain the full caption transcript per session (#103387)

question: Should post-meeting Google Meet transcripts be bounded volatile gateway state, or durable plugin-owned SQLite state?
rationale: The PR exposes user-visible post-meeting data while defining irreversible restart, line-cap, and ended-session eviction semantics that are not established by the current plugin contract.

options.title: Persist in plugin SQLite
options.body: Store transcript lines and cursor metadata in plugin-owned SQLite with an explicit cleanup lifecycle.

options.title: Accept volatile retention
options.body: Ship the documented memory-only contract with explicit acceptance of restart loss, a 2000-line cap, and four most-recently-ended transcripts.

recommendation.title: Persist in plugin SQLite
recommendation.body: Store transcript lines and cursor metadata in plugin-owned SQLite with an explicit cleanup lifecycle.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged history most strongly connects this person to Google Meet plugin direction, caption collection, and session lifecycle behavior.
